title: Radiant Silvergun
native_title: レイディアント・シルバーガン
overview:
7 hours until the annihilation of mankind...

Treasure's first arcade shooting game, powered up for the Sega Saturn

An ancient artifact called the Stone-Like is unearthed and wipes out all life on Earth. Only the crew of the orbiting spaceship Tetra survives. A year later they return, and you take the controls of a Silvergun prototype fighter to confront the Stone-Like and its forces in this vertically scrolling shooter.

There are no power-ups to collect. All seven weapons are available from the start, selected by pressing the three fire buttons alone or in combination, and each grows stronger as you score with it. Use the Radiant Sword to cut down enemies up close and absorb pink bullets, destroy every section of a boss for bonus points, and chain kills of the same color for extra score.

- Saturn Mode adds a story told through animated cutscenes, plus the Arcade Mode
- One or two players at once
- Memory backup

人類全滅まであと7時間・・・

トレジャー初の業務用シューティングゲームをセガサターン用にパワーアップ
